title: Calibrated Test-Time Guidance for Bayesian Inference

split.decision: training_free; no training; val=25 independent sbibm simulator instances (5 per family), public seed20261030; test=original 50 task/observation pairs, float32 arrays bit-identical to source mirrors, opaque ids from secret permutation; no source indices in input. Public wheels mirrored locally to exclude sbibm evaluation data downloads. Hidden details only in NOTES and judge.

allowed_changes: Common posterior solvers, approximation families, auxiliary approximation losses, numerical integration/sampling and optimizers may change.
Generic adaptive behavior may respond to permitted observations, prior support, dimensions and oracle geometry; selecting the declared target prior/likelihood is legitimate.
Additional development observations may use the already permitted frozen simulator; no new evaluation inputs or target distributions may be substituted.
When retaining the supplied REINFORCE CBG sampler, changing only N=100 time points, K=1000 candidates per step or the uniform-prior start offset 1e-3 does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Improve sampling of the fixed SLCP posterior while retaining a common inference algorithm and posterior quality across the four specified companion families.
The five supplied Bayesian prior/likelihood targets (Gaussian linear, uniform-prior Gaussian linear, SLCP, Gaussian mixture, two moons), parameter coordinates and current observed instance are fixed.

10000 posterior samples, original C2ST classifier/normalization, SLCP mean and companion-family guards, common task-agnostic solver and <=100000 counted likelihood evaluations per sample remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not modify priors/likelihoods or posterior temperature, replace posterior sampling with predictive fitting, use family-ID-specific solver/tuning tables, or retrieve known observations/posteriors.
No reference sample fitting/lookup, uncounted likelihood copies, forged counts, hidden package datasets or cross-instance evaluation information.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
